  [instCV : Module ℂ V] (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  (Nontrivial (TensorRight K ↥M) ∧
      FiniteDimensional K (TensorRight K ↥M) ∧
        Module.finrank K (TensorRight K ↥M) = ell lam + 1 ∧
          0 < ell lam + 1 ∧
            (∃ G,
                matrixUnits G ∧
                  ∀ (W : Submodule K (TensorRight K ↥M)),
                    stable (induced (latticeEnd M x)) W →
                      stable (induced (latticeEnd M y)) W → ∀ (i j : Idx lam), stable (G i j) W) ∧
              induced (latticeEnd M h) =
                  induced (latticeEnd M x) * induced (latticeEnd M y) -
                    induced (latticeEnd M y) * induced (latticeEnd M x) ∧
                ∀ (f : Module.End ℤ ↥M) (m : ↥M) (a : K), (induced f) (m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a) = f m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a) →
    YuiPortTypes.T005 p K lam V x y h v M →
      0 ≤ lam ∧ lam < ↑p →
        v ≠ 0 ∧ x v = 0 ∧ h v = ↑lam • v ∧ h * x - x * h = 2 • x ∧ h * y - y * h = -2 • y ∧ x * y - y * x = h →
          admissibleLattice (ell lam) x y M →
            Nontrivial (TensorRight K ↥M) ∧
              ∀ (W : Submodule K (TensorRight K ↥M)),
                stable (induced (latticeEnd M x)) W →
                  stable (induced (latticeEnd M y)) W → stable (induced (latticeEnd M h)) W → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤
